You can use 蒜蓉豆苗 as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about food.
It is often listed in restaurant menus as a dish name without any modifiers.
The phrase can be combined with verbs like 'eat', 'order', or 'cook' to describe actions involving the dish.
When describing the dish, you can add adjectives before 蒜蓉豆苗, for example, 'delicious 蒜蓉豆苗'.
